summary: Implemented prepareUpdate following the prepareQuery pattern. Changes: (1) rdflib/plugins/sparql/sparql.py adds an Update class holding the translated algebra list. (2) rdflib/plugins/sparql/processor.py adds prepareUpdate(updateString, initNs={}, base=None) which wraps translateUpdate output in Update and sets _original_args. (3) rdflib/plugins/sparql/update.py: evalUpdate unwraps an Update into its algebra list. (4) rdflib/plugins/sparql/__init__.py exports prepareUpdate. (5) New test/test_sparql_prepare_update.py with five unittest cases. Nothing was run, per the instructions, so tests are unverified. The initBindings test (DELETE/INSERT with ?new supplied via initBindings) is the most likely to fail if _fillTemplate does not resolve initial bindings. Nothing was committed. processUpdate remains string-only; SPARQLUpdateProcessor.update already accepts prepared objects via evalUpdate.
